verdict.rationale: The only story-specific evidence is a community comment that AnythingLLM itself supports TTS/STT, so speaking replies and transcribing voice input are plausible. First-party docs here cover only meeting transcription, which is a separate meeting-notes feature, not voice chat. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of voice input/dictation in chat, spoken replies (TTS) in chat, live voice conversation mode, and hands-on corroboration of the voice workflow.

support.subject: As a power user, I can interact by voice — voice notes get transcribed, replies can be spoken, or live voice conversations are supported

citations.quote: The commenter noted it supports embedding models, vector databases, and TTS/STT, everything needed to build a fully functioning voice chatbot.
